facts.value: The Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for studying (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The Goethe University Telephone Hotline helps with questions regarding application, semester dates, re-registration, change of subjects, double study, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: International Student Services provide information for international students on residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, career, and more. Support and advice are also available.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters, providing necessary infrastructure in training support, student housing, cafeterias, and counseling services to ensure successful studying.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
